findings.summary: Float values in the DiskPreflightError message could result in overly long decimal strings and should be formatted using .toFixed(2).
findings.suggested_fix: Update the default message in DiskPreflightError to: `Insufficient disk space: ${result.availableGb.toFixed(2)} GB available, but ${result.minFreeDiskGb.toFixed(2)} GB required for reservation (model footprint: ${result.modelFootprintGb.toFixed(2)} GB)`
